statement: A number machine doubles whatever number goes in and then subtracts $3$. Jun puts a number into the machine, puts the result back into the machine, and then puts that result in once more. The final number that comes out is $11$. What number did Jun start with?

choices.misconception: I worked backwards by adding 3 and halving, but I only undid the machine twice: 11 to 7 to 5.
I undid the machine once, (11 + 3) / 2 = 7, and forgot that the number went through three times.
I put 11 into the machine once, 2 times 11 - 3 = 19, instead of undoing the machine.
I ran 11 forward through the machine three times, 11 to 19 to 35 to 67, instead of working backwards.

hints: Start from $11$ and undo the machine.
To undo "double, then subtract $3$", do the opposite steps in the opposite order: add $3$, then halve.
Undoing once takes $11$ to $7$. Undo two more times.

solutions.reliable: Undo each pass by adding $3$ and then halving: $11 \to 7 \to 5 \to 4$. Check forward: $4 \to 2 \cdot 4 - 3 = 5 \to 2 \cdot 5 - 3 = 7 \to 2 \cdot 7 - 3 = 11$.
solutions.elegant: Three passes turn $x$ into $2(2(2x - 3) - 3) - 3 = 8x - 21$. Setting $8x - 21 = 11$ gives $x = 4$.

author: Devansh Sanghavi
